instruction: Convert this RAW file to TIFF with 16-bit color depth.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because the file is not a true RAW file - it's a JPEG (baseline, precision 8, 3 components) with only 8-bit color depth per channel. When GIMP opens this JPEG, it loads it as an 8-bit image. Converting an 8-bit JPEG to 16-bit TIFF does not recover the original RAW 16-bit color data because that data never existed in the JPEG format. The task asks for a RAW-to-TIFF conversion that cannot happen since there is no RAW source data.
